content: Simple microservices architecture on AWS - Implementing Microservices on AWS View a markdown version of this page Simple microservices architecture on AWS - Implementing Microservices on AWS Documentation AWS Whitepapers AWS Whitepaper Simple microservices architecture on AWS Typical monolithic applications consist of different layers: a presentation layer, an application layer, and a data layer. Microservices architectures, on the other hand, separate functionalities into cohesive verticals according to specific domains, rather than technological layers.
